detection.note: reconstruct=False (DL default), minimize=False; every hazard is structural so the read-out is identical to a full prepare
detection.clashscore_note: templated-atom denominator (matches PrepReport.clashscore / the gate); un-templated ligand/metal atoms excluded

binary_gate_comparison.note: the old binary 'any clash' gate flagged 99% and rejected essentially all PDB

repair_drop.note: heavy_coords policy: reconstruct + select altloc/model + DROP on severe clash; n=150
repair_drop.finding: with clashes demoted to a severity gate, structural incompleteness (reconstruct cannot rebuild whole missing residues/loops) is the binding constraint, not sterics

repair_relax.note: heavy_coords policy with severe_heavy_clashes=relax (heavy minimization on the severe subset only); n=80
repair_relax.finding: relax clears the severe clash on 28/30 structures (only 2 relax_failed) vs 1/39 under the old binary zero-clash gate -- because the target is clashscore<=20, not exactly 0; but overall yield 15% barely beats drop's 10% since most severe-clash structures are also incomplete (reconstruct_failed)
